A little about the person behind the papers
How I got here

It started with
“what if I try this?”

Still a very good question.

I grew up in a farming community, happiest with a circuit board, a DIY idea, or a toy I could build myself. The first in my family to pursue higher education, I followed that curiosity to IIT Ropar, then into research at IIT Delhi, and now a PhD at the University of Virginia. Getting into an IIT took some serious work; getting to keep experimenting made it worth it. These days I work with lasers, materials, and automation. The experiments have become slightly more expensive, but the instinct is the same: understand how something works, try an idea, and make something useful. I’m fortunate that the thing I loved as a kid became the work I get to do.

Still curious. Still building. Occasionally, it even works on the first try.
